notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.4.0 - Lightlands - Major Update
notes.content:
Back in July this year, we released the first publicly available version of Ravensword: Undaunted. While a lot of players find the gameplay engaging, some of them think that the RPG elements are not satisfying. Thus, we started numerous experiments to improve the game design, through multiple iterations, we finally came out with an idea that leads to this update.


[b][h2]Lightlands[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/ebcd8d7776f4ed761b2ef701ad0c460dc1f64460.png[/img]

[i]Traverse through the Lightlands and discover various rifts of realities within, a portal to alternate past, and a grim prophecy of the future. Travel into an altered future of Tyreas where humanity has ceased to exist. Beware and tread lightly, as the Lightlands has been overrun by a mysterious being called “The Shapes”, seemingly tinkering with time, making the Lightlands dangerous and the alternate dimension all corrupted.[/i]

Lightlands, a randomly generated alternate dimension where gravity works differently. Before entering the zone, you must first find the portal to leave the lightlands.


[b][h2]Game Design Update[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Weapons[/h3][/u]
In v0.4, instead of looting weapons from the levels and storing them in inventory, players can now unlock the weapons in the hub, and bring a maximum of three weapons to the adventure.

Weapons can be upgraded by spending shards, a currency that can be earned through killing enemies. Shards can also be used to unlock weapon's perks, allowing a more dynamic and rewarding gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/3bc9bb8f2d29a000e668cf0ca79b09ed0bf80143.png[/img]

[u][h3]Combat[/h3][/u]
Stamina has been completely removed. There is still a limit on how many attacks can be blocked by a melee weapon. Dash does not cost anything, but it comes with a short cooldown.

Shield is introduced in this version, it behaves as a buffer to the damage received by the player, it will be regenerated when player is not being attacked for a certain amount of time.

Shards can be used to increase character's HP and Shield, or unlocking perks, replacing the character's stats found in the previous version of the game.


[u][h3]The Hub[/h3][/u]
Hub has been redesigned to accommodate the changes to the weapons. Players can directly upgrade or unlock weapons through the weaponry in the hub, and improve HP and Shield through the shrine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/39583ffc259aee0dd6156b653cf486df408a769b.png[/img]


[i]We hope that you enjoy the new update, we'd like to hear from your feedback![/i]

notes.title: v0.3.0 Wretched Woods Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Revamped Wretched Woods zone.
- Adjusted weapon drop rate.
- Adjusted weapon rarity.
- Added Crossbow that deals physical damage.
- Added werewolf enemy.
- Improved ragdolls.
- Added parry for melee weapons.
- Breaking barrels now drop mana.
- Added ability to reset character points.
- Added UI sound effects.

[i]We advice players to start a new game for better progression experience.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/4cdee998ee5990740631ffa8730eadb76bf468de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/7133d5b444cc9a6662afe43dff295f373ce12712.png[/img]

notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.2.0 Corruption Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New:[/b]
- Introduce a revamped weapon degradation system. Weapons gradually become corrupted as player uses it. When a weapon is completely corrupted, it becomes unusable, but it will stay in the inventory. Player can then bring it back to the Merchant to cleanse it.
- Updated HUD and improved inventory UI.
- Greatly reduced weapon spawn rate.
- Decreased spawn rate of higher tier weapons.
- Added a count down text in "Stay in Circle" trap room.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
- Jump while dashing increase the travel distance.
- Incorrect progress UI in "Stay in Circle" trap room.


[i]Inventory with corrupted weapons[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220219/b03ea7838e26ccdca2b42409c7b6c7704e403980.png[/img]

notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.1.13 Stamina Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New[/b]
- Stamina now in charge form, each successful Block or Dash costs one charge of Stamina.
- Increased player's movement speed and removed sprinting.
- Overhauled the HUD, now shows the exact value of each player's stats.
- Slightly increased Dash distance.
- Options to toggle crosshair and damage text.
- Increased the brightness of the levels.

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
- Failed to block when player is looking upwards.

notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.1.12 Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New[/b]
- Added field of view slider.
- Maximum Health now gradually increases as you level up.
- Updated a trap room in Blackwood Keep.
- Readjusted the weapon degradation system.

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
- Audio sliders not working.

notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.1.11 Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New[/b]
- Reduced weapon degradation speed and improved durability of higher tier weapons.
- Increased Shardith damage.
- Ability to reset the game and start over.
- More key bindings options.

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
- Melee weapons degrade even when not hitting anything.
- Some maps in Wretched Woods repeat itself.

notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted v0.1.10 Update
notes.content:
[b]What's New[/b]
- Introducing Repair feature, you can now repair your weapons with the merchant in the hideout.
- Added key rebinding support.
- The suicide zombie now rewards player on dead.

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
- Unable to leave a room in Blackwood Keep.
- Invert mouse setting not persistent.
- Fullscreen settings not functioning as it should.
